scripts.text:
[Metto]
In the Lab today, in the Lab tomorrow! Everyday is filled with research! Even if it takes my entire life, I will not give up until I have made a new Juno...
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
今天在實驗室，明天也在實驗室！每天都在做研究！即使耗盡一生，我也不會放棄，直到造出一座新的朱諾...

scripts.text:
[Metto]
I'm going to ask my colleague ^FF0000Stangckle^000000 to help me. I am sure he will be more than willing to help out an old friend.
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
我要請我的同事^FF0000斯坦克爾^000000來幫忙。我相信他一定會樂意幫助一位老朋友的。

scripts.text:
[Metto]
What? That punk Stangckle said he doesn't want to help me?! This is not good. This will slow my research considerably.
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
什麼？那個混混斯坦克爾說不想幫我？！這可不好。這會大大拖慢我的研究進度。

scripts.text:
[Metto]
What? You mean to tell me that the very thing I need to continue my research, the mighty Great Z, has been destroyed?!!
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
什麼？你是說，我繼續研究所必需的強大機器“大Z”被毀掉了？！

scripts.text:
[Metto]
...

[Metto]
Maybe I should look into a job change. I hear it is a popular decision these days.
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
也許我該考慮一下轉職。聽說最近這很流行。

scripts.text:
[Metto]
I better get going to check this new thing out. What are you still doing here? I'll be leaving in a bit.
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
我得趕緊去看看這個新東西。你還待在這裡幹什麼？我過一會兒就走。

scripts.text:
[Metto]
A new Juno in which all will bask in the light of my genius! If I can just harness the power of flight... I know I can do it!
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
我要造一座全新的朱諾，讓所有人都沐浴在我的天才光芒中！只要能掌握飛行的力量...我一定能做到！

scripts.text:
[Metto]
^FF0000Wagan^000000 said that my idea was crazy and impossible. But I am no fool, I won't be swayed by his words of mockery!
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
^FF0000瓦甘^000000說我的想法很瘋狂，不可能實現。但我不是傻瓜，我不會被他嘲諷的話語動搖！

scripts.text:
[Metto]
If I had that fellow's help, this would be much easier. Pray! Pray to whatever God you believe that we will succeed!
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
如果那傢伙肯幫忙，事情就容易多了。祈禱吧！向你信仰的神明祈禱，願我們成功！

scripts.text:
[Metto]
...
What will
I do now?!
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
...我現在該怎麼辦？！

scripts.text:
[Metto]
Luckily, I have a back up plan. I am positive that my friend and colleague ^FF0000Kato^000000 will lend his aid.
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
幸好，我還有備用計劃。我確信我的朋友兼同事^FF0000加藤^000000會伸出援手。

scripts.text:
[Metto]
If I can only study his super robot, Great Z, I can continue my research...
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
只要我能研究一下他的超級機器人，大Z，我就能繼續我的研究...

scripts.text:
[Metto]
I guess if Stangckle doesn't want to help me, he can have it his way. I must continue my research, whether or not he helps me.
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
看來如果斯坦克爾不想幫我，那就隨他去吧。無論他幫不幫我，我都必須繼續我的研究。

scripts.text:
[Metto]
Expect great things, young friend. Muahahahha.
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
期待著吧，年輕的朋友。Muahahahha.

scripts.text:
[Metto]
Nooooo~!! Why? Why would they do that? Are the Gods cursing me?!
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
不——！！為什麼？為什麼他們要這麼做？是諸神在詛咒我嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Metto]
Wait, I need...
To calm down...
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
等等，我需要...
冷靜下來...

scripts.text:
[Metto]
If I can just get the help of professor ^FF0000CiCi^000000 with his Riding Engine theory, I might be able to finish my research...
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
如果我能得到教授^FF0000西西^000000的騎乘引擎理論幫助，或許就能完成我的研究...

scripts.text:
[Metto]
I still
have hope!
Ha! Ha! Ha!
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
我還有希望！
Ha! Ha! Ha!

scripts.text:
[Metto]
How can this happen 3 times in a row? Its true, the Gods have forsaken me! I'm ruined... RUINED!!!
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
怎麼會連續三次都這樣？看來諸神真的拋棄我了！我完蛋了...徹底完蛋了！！！

scripts.text:
[Metto]
What can I do now...? Has the time really come for me to forfeit all my years of research?
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
我現在該怎麼辦...？難道真的到了放棄多年研究成果的時候了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Metto]
I know I've disappointed you, but please, forget all about me.
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
我知道我讓你失望了，但求你，忘了我吧。

scripts.text:
[Metto]
Who would do this to me? What kind of malicious person would shatter a man's dreams??
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
是誰這樣對我？到底是什麼惡人，竟然粉碎了一個人的夢想？！

scripts.text:
[Metto]
I'm tired of this. I think that the time has come for me to give up. It's all over. Please don't be too disappointed...
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
我受夠了。我想是時候放棄了。一切都結束了。請不要太失望...

scripts.text:
[Metto]
I wonder what I should look into? All I know for sure is that I don't want to be scientist anymore. I'm done with research...
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
我該研究些什麼好呢？我只確定一件事，我不想再當科學家了。我厭倦了研究...

scripts.text:
[Metto]
I need to get ready! You go ahead and take off, I'll be going out soon.
scripts.translation:
[梅托]
我得準備一下！你先去吧，我馬上就來。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
I'm sure that you know our city has been living off our research for many years.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
我想你也知道，我們這座城市多年來一直靠研究成果發展。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
Thank you for your help. Because of your work in ridding us of Metto, we have one less worry.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
謝謝你的幫助。多虧你幫我們擺脫了梅托，我們少了一樁煩心事。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
Things around here seem much more peaceful without that Metto around. Thanks for your help.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
梅托不在這裡搗亂，周圍似乎平靜多了。謝謝你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
How goes your work with Metto? Hopefully the plan is going well. I'm sorry to bother you with such a task.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
你和梅托的事進展如何？希望計劃進行順利。抱歉給你添了這樣的麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
We owe this quality of life to those who have dedicated their lives to research and study.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
我們能過上這樣的生活，要感謝那些畢生致力於研究的人。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
So we help each other and study together. It is nice to have such solid support around when we are conducting research.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
所以大家互相幫助、共同研究。做研究時，有這麼多人堅定地支援彼此，真好。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
But there are those few bad apples that just drive me crazy...
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
但總有那麼幾個害群之馬，真是讓我頭疼...

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
It's good to try hard, but there are those selfish and crazy mad scientists that make things harder for the rest of us.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
努力嘗試是好事，但有些自私又瘋狂的科學家讓其他人的處境變得更艱難。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
Out of all those, ^FF0000Metto^000000 must be the worst by far. He's into crazy things...
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
在所有這些人中，^FF0000梅托^000000肯定是最糟糕的。他總搞些瘋狂的事情...

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
For science, he's destroyed public facilities, has been the cause of noise and air pollution and generally disturbing the peace...
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
為了科學，他破壞公共設施，造成噪音和空氣汙染，還總是擾亂大家的安寧...

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
And he's justifying his behavior under the excuse of research! He's a crazy fellow who's taken it too far!
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
他還以研究為藉口為自己的行為辯護！他是個走火入魔的瘋子！

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
I wish there was a way that we could stop him from wrecking it for the rest of us. Some brave, daring soul should be able to do something...
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
我真希望有辦法阻止他繼續破壞大家的生活...總該有個勇敢無畏的人能做點什麼...

scripts.text: Leave it to me.
scripts.translation: 交給我吧

scripts.text: I wish your village luck in doing so.
scripts.translation: 祝你們村莊好運

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
Hmm...
Thanks for the offer, but I don't think this is something that you could do...
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
嗯...
謝謝你的提議，但我覺得這事你辦不到...

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
I think we need someone a bit harsher to help us out. I think it would be a little too much for a Novice.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
我覺得需要更強硬的人來幫忙。初心者恐怕難以勝任。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
Please don't be
offended by this.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
請不要介意。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
Oh, are you going to take care of this for us? We would be very grateful.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
哦，你要為我們處理這件事嗎？我們會非常感激的。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
But how do you plan to go about doing this? I'm guessing it's harder than it sounds...
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
但你打算怎麼做？我猜這事比聽起來難得多...

scripts.text: Of course I have a plan.
scripts.translation: 我當然有計劃

scripts.text: I guess I need a plan.
scripts.translation: 我想我需要想個計劃

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
I have faith in you. You should know that he believes in fate. Use that to your advantage.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
我相信你。你應該知道，他很相信命運。好好利用這一點。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
I feel much better knowing you will take care of this little problem...
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
知道你會處理這個小麻煩，我感覺好多了...

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
Hmmm... I admire your zeal, but how do you expect to accomplish anything without a plan?
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
嗯...我佩服你的熱情，但沒有計劃，你打算怎麼完成這件事？

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
You need a ruse to trick him into quitting. Something subtle, like... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
你得設個計策騙他放棄。要巧妙些，比如...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
...Sabotaging his experiments and making it look like it was his destiny to fail!
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
...破壞他的實驗，再讓他以為失敗就是他的命運！

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
He's talkative, so if you approach him, he'll tell you all you need to know.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
他話很多，如果你接近他，他會告訴你你需要知道的一切。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
Yeah...
I've been thinking of this plan for a while...
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
是的...我考慮這個計劃已經有一段時間了...

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
We will have to pray for fate to help us. Now to think of it, Metto is a strong believer in fate.
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
我們得祈求命運助我們一臂之力。說起來，梅托很相信命運。

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
If only we could use that to our advantage...
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
如果我們能利用這一點就好了...

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
I'm sure the people of Juno are very thankful. Here is a little token of our appreciation...
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
朱諾的居民一定很感激。這是我們的一點謝意...

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
Oh no, it seems that you are carrying too much stuff! Would you make some room?
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
糟糕，你攜帶的東西太多了！能騰出點空間嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
I wish you luck in your future endeavors...
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
祝你在未來的冒險中好運...

scripts.text:
[Wagan]
Oh no, it seems that you are carrying too much! Would you make some room?
scripts.translation:
[瓦甘]
糟糕，你攜帶的東西太多了！能騰出點空間嗎？

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
What can I do for you? My colleague Metto is coming here soon, so I don't have much time. So what did you say you needed?
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？我的同事梅托馬上就要來了，所以我沒多少時間。你說你需要什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
I am one of the scientists in this city. My name is Stangckle.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
我是這座城裡的科學家之一。我叫斯坦克爾。

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
So Metto has become one of those mad scientists. I guess that is the choice he has ultimately made for his life.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
看來梅托成了那種瘋狂科學家。我想，這就是他最終選擇的人生道路。

scripts.text: I'm here to stop your research.
scripts.translation: 我來阻止你的研究。

scripts.text: I don't need anything.
scripts.translation: 我什麼都不需要

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
...
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
...

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
...
......
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
...

[斯坦克爾]
...

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
Is that true?? Metto doesn't think of me as a colleague, but still wants me to help him?!
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
真的嗎？！梅托不把我當同事，卻還想讓我幫他？！

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
He only sees me as an assistant and is going to steal all the credit for our discoveries?!
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
他只把我當助手，還想獨佔我們所有發現的功勞？！

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
This guy can't be trusted! The rumors were true: he really is mad!
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
這傢伙信不過！傳言果然沒錯：他真瘋了！

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
And to think, I really respected that traitor! I can't even stand to see that guy's face anymore.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
沒想到，我竟然那麼尊重那個叛徒！我現在連看他的臉都受不了了。

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
I'm glad that an honest, trustworthy person such as yourself had the guts to tell me. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
幸好你這樣誠實可靠的人有勇氣告訴我真相。謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
Now if you'll excuse me, I have work to do.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
那麼，失陪了，我還有工作要做。

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
What are you doing then? Stop wasting my time.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
那你到底在幹什麼？別浪費我的時間。

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
You should remember my name, it may be useful to you in the future.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
你應該記住我的名字，將來可能會對你有用。

scripts.text:
[Stangckle]
You should remember my name, it may be useful to you in the future.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦克爾]
你應該記住我的名字，將來可能會對你有用。

scripts.text:
[Kato]
I am a scientist researching all sorts of things.
scripts.translation:
[加藤]
我是一名研究各種領域的科學家。

scripts.text:
[Kato]
I am interested in researching artificial intelligence. You know, like robots.
scripts.translation:
[加藤]
我對人工智慧很感興趣。你知道的，比如機器人。

scripts.text:
[Kato]
I am a scientist of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics.
scripts.translation:
[加藤]
我是一名研究人工智慧和機器人的科學家。

scripts.text:
[Kato]
Of course, my research is private and confidential. But is there anything I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[加藤]
當然，我的研究是保密的。不過，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: I want to stop you from making a mistake.
scripts.translation: 我想阻止你犯錯誤

scripts.text: Just saying hello.
scripts.translation: 只是打個招呼

scripts.text:
[Kato]
What? Metto said, my Great Z is inferior to Stangckles research?!
scripts.translation:
[加藤]
什麼？梅托說我的“大Z”比不上斯坦克爾的研究？！

scripts.text:
[Kato]
H-he said I should rename my invention to 'Lame Z?' *Sniff* I... I don't believe it... *Sob*
scripts.translation:
[加藤]
他...他說我應該把發明改名叫“爛Z”？*吸吸鼻子* 我...我不相信...*嗚嗚*

scripts.text:
[Kato]
I-If my invention is no good, then I guess I should destroy my Great Z... *sigh*
scripts.translation:
[加藤]
如...如果我的發明不怎麼樣，那我想我該毀掉我的“大Z”... *嘆氣*

scripts.text:
[Kato]
Thank you for letting me know. I know it wasn't easy to tell me.
scripts.translation:
[加藤]
謝謝你告訴我。我知道這對你來說並不容易開口。

scripts.text:
[Kato]
I know it a very difficult feat to accomplish, but where there's a will, there's a way.
scripts.translation:
[加藤]
我知道這非常難做到，但世上無難事，只怕有心人。

scripts.text:
[Kato]
If you ever see something really amazing like this, you'll know its my handiwork.
scripts.translation:
[加藤]
如果你以後看到像這樣真正驚人的東西，你就知道那是我的傑作。

scripts.text:
[Kato]
I don't have a specific project right now, but my latest creation, the 'Great Z,' is truly a product of sheer and utter genius.
scripts.translation:
[加藤]
我現在沒有具體專案，不過我最新的發明“大Z”確實是十足天才的傑作。

scripts.text:
[CiCi]
My name is CiCi. I am one of the three great scientists in this city.
scripts.translation:
[西西]
我叫西西。我是這座城市三大科學家之一。

scripts.text:
[CiCi]
There are many great scientists in this city, but being in the top three is a true honor. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[西西]
這座城市有很多偉大的科學家，但能進入前三可是真正的榮譽。你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
[CiCi]
Well, I think I've bragged a little too much now, what can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[西西]
哎呀，我覺得我吹牛吹得有點多了，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: I want to warn you.
scripts.translation: 我想警告你

scripts.text: Nothing, just saying Hi.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼，只是打個招呼

scripts.text:
[CiCi]
Hm? Metto said that he doesn't need my Riding Engine theory?! Hmpf, what an ingrate!
scripts.translation:
[西西]
嗯？梅托說他不需要我的騎乘引擎理論？！哼，真是忘恩負義！

scripts.text:
[CiCi]
I have half a mind to teach him a little something about true science and intelligent research.
scripts.translation:
[西西]
我真想教教他，什麼才是真正的科學和嚴謹的研究。

scripts.text:
[CiCi]
He thinks that I owe him an apology?! For what? Why should I apologize...?!
scripts.translation:
[西西]
他覺得我該向他道歉？！憑什麼？我為什麼要道歉...？！

scripts.text:
[CiCi]
Whatever, I really didn't have the necessary parts to help him anyway. I guess, either way, he would not have had a chance.
scripts.translation:
[西西]
算了，反正我也沒有必要的零件來幫他。我想，無論如何，他都沒戲。

scripts.text:
[CiCi]
Let him know I really don't want to be a part of what he is doing. He isn't even doing the type of research that we would be able to publicize.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Shalima]
When you go north from Al De Baran, you will arrive at 'Elmeth Plateau,' a place covered with molten rock.
scripts.translation:
[沙利瑪]
從艾爾帕蘭往北走，就會到達覆蓋著熔岩的“埃爾梅斯高原”。

scripts.text:
[Shalima]
On the top of a mountain connected to the plateau, you can find a bridge which leads you to this place!, ^3355FFJuno,^000000 the city of Sages.
scripts.translation:
[沙利瑪]
連線著高原的山頂上有一座橋，通往賢者之城^3355FF朱諾^000000！

scripts.text:
[Shalima]
Oh...?
what is that shining object you're carrying with you? Isn't that...?
scripts.translation:
[沙利瑪]
哦...？
你手裡拿著的那個閃閃發光的物體是什麼？
難道那是...？

scripts.text:
[Shalima]
The ^3355FFStamp of Muriniel^000000? What a surprise!
scripts.translation:
[沙利瑪]
^3355FF穆里尼爾印章^000000？真是令人驚訝！

scripts.text:
[Shalima]
When you go East from the entrance of Juno, you will find the Street of Book Stores. If you have some time, please visit ^3355FFSir Yklah^000000 who is one of 3 well-known sages in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[沙利瑪]
從朱諾入口往東走，你會找到書店街。有空的話，請去拜訪^3355FF伊克拉^000000，他是朱諾三位著名賢者之一。

scripts.text:
[Shalima]
I believe he may take some special interest in the Stamp you are carrying.
scripts.translation:
[沙利瑪]
我想他可能會對你攜帶的印章產生特別的興趣。

scripts.text:
[Shalima]
In Juno, you can visit places such as the 'Juphero Plaza,' 'Juno Conference Hall,' 'Schweicherbil Magic Academy', or the 'Monster Museum.' These places are famous around the world!
scripts.translation:
[沙利瑪]
在朱諾，你可以參觀“朱菲羅廣場”、“朱諾會議廳”、“施韋切爾比爾魔法學院”或“魔物博物館”。這些地方都聞名遐邇！

scripts.text:
[Shalima]
You may also wish to drop by the 'Sage Castle,' where people can change their jobs into 'Sage,' one of the more unique classes.
scripts.translation:
[沙利瑪]
你也可以去“賢者城堡”看看，那裡可以將職業轉職為“賢者”，這是一種比較獨特的職業。

scripts.text:
[Shalima]
If you're interested in the Sage class, why don't you go look around the castle?
scripts.translation:
[沙利瑪]
如果你對賢者職業感興趣，不妨去城堡裡轉轉？

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
- ! ! ! -

[Yklah]
That item...
That shining item you're carrying, isn't that...? ^3355FFStamp of Muriniel^000000?! Oh! What a surprise!
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
那個物品...你帶著的那件閃亮物品，難道是...？^3355FF穆里尼爾印章^000000？！真令人驚訝！

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
I've heard that it's from a hot and dry land, but I never dreamed I'd be able to see it with my own eyes!
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
我聽說它來自炎熱乾燥的土地，但我從未想過能親眼見到它！

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Who are you...? Who are you carrying this legendary item for?
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
你是誰...？你替誰保管著這件傳奇物品？

scripts.text: (Show him the slate)
scripts.translation: (給他看石板)

scripts.text: I'm a genius!
scripts.translation: 我是個天才！

scripts.text: I'm a GM!
scripts.translation: 我是GM！

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
...I can't believe my eyes! Only a chosen few can possess the Stamp of Muriniel...
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
...我簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛！只有少數被選中的人才能擁有穆里尼爾印章...

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Oh yes. That's right, that's right. As far as I can tell, you don't seem to understand how to use this item...
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
哦，是的，沒錯，沒錯。據我觀察，你似乎並不瞭解如何使用這個物品...

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
There is one old song in Juno, about ^3355FF'The Doomed Sword'^000000 that you may have been looking for.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
朱諾有一首古老的歌謠，關於^3355FF“命運之劍”^000000，也許你一直在尋找的就是它。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
'Even if you're running toward a light on the other side of the mist, you can't reach it.'
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
“即使奔向迷霧彼端的光，也無法抵達。”

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
'The chime of the bell from across the valley cannot be held in your hand.'
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
“山谷對岸傳來的鐘聲，無法握在手中。”

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Yes, it's sort of a difficult song to understand, but it's supposed to express how Sages in ancient times feel about obtaining the doomed swords.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
是的，這首歌確實很難懂，但據說它表達了古代賢者對獲得命運之劍一事的感受。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
If you're still set on the idea of obtaining the doomed sword, come and talk to me sometime.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
如果你仍然堅持要獲得命運之劍，隨時可以來找我談談。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
As you already possess the Stamp of Muriniel, I am more than willing to help you.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
既然你已經擁有了穆里尼爾印章，我非常樂意幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Hmm?
A genius you say? How can you say that in a city full of wise men? That's nothing special.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
嗯？
你說你是天才？
在一個充滿智者的城市裡，這算什麼特別的事？

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Plus, if you're a colleague, I think I would remember you. I don't tend to forget people that I've met at least once.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
而且，如果你是我的同事，我想我會記得你。我通常不會忘記至少見過一次面的人。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
A...
GM?
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
什...GM？

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
I don't understand what you're talking about. But there's an ancient Juno song about this GM you speak of...
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
我不明白你在說什麼。不過，朱諾有一首關於你所說的GM的古老歌謠...

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
'^FF3355Impersonating GMs is punishable with a permanent account block^000000.' But what could it possibly mean?
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
“^FF3355冒充GM者將被永久封號^000000。”但這到底是什麼意思呢？

scripts.text: ^3355FFHow depressing!^000000

[Yklah]

scripts.translation:

嗯！幹得好，你把所有物品都帶來了。試著把它們插進凹槽裡。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]

scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
說實話，我之前想過這個問題，但這是我第一次真正嘗試這個實驗。繼續吧，我想看看會發生什麼！

in the grooves .^000000

^3355FFYou hear a strange sound come from inside the statue.^000000
scripts.translation:

^3355FF你聽到雕像內部傳來奇怪的聲音。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Click*
*Click Click*^000000
^3355FFA small hole opened near the foot of the statue, and a ^9999FF Stamp of Muriniel^3355FF came out of the hole.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF雕像腳邊開了一個小孔，一枚^9999FF穆里尼爾印章^3355FF從孔中彈了出來。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou got ^9999FFA piece from the Stamp of Muriniel^3355FF.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你獲得了^9999FF穆里尼爾印章碎片^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Huh?! That piece seems to fit to the stamp you have. Why don't you try joining them together?
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
咦？！那個碎片似乎能和你手上的印章拼合。試著把它們拼在一起吧。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou join the two stamps together.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你將兩塊印章碎片拼合在一起。^000000

scripts.text:

True Stamp of Muriniel.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你獲得了
穆里尼爾真印章。^000000

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Oh? This pattern is...!! Ah, now I see how it works. Now, please listen...
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
哦？這個圖案是...！！啊，我明白它的用途了。現在請聽我說...

scripts.text:

I'd like you to bring the slate to Snotora, the island of knowledge, that is a part of Juno. You will find a Statue of the Goddess Snotora somewhere on the island.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
請把石板帶到朱諾所屬的知識之島斯諾托拉。你會在島上找到一尊斯諾托拉女神像。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Near the statue, you will find ^3355FFSyklah^000000, one of well-known 3 sages in Juno. Speak to him, he will tell you something about the pattern on the slate.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
雕像附近有^3355FF西克拉^000000，朱諾三位著名賢者之一。和他談談，他會告訴你石板上圖案的含義。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
May God
light your way...
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
願神明指引你的道路...

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Let me tell you everything I know about the doomed sword. There's an old song about the legendary doomed sword...
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
讓我把關於命運之劍的事都告訴你。關於這把傳奇的命運之劍，有一首古老歌謠...

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
^3355FFYou, the one with sincere faith, who humbly accepts the prosperity of Mineta, the knowledge of Snotora and the honor of Solomon...^000000
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
^3355FF你，心懷虔誠信念之人，謙遜地接受米內塔的繁榮、斯諾托拉的知識和所羅門的榮耀...^000000

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
^3355FFI hereby grant you this column of light. The Three Sages of Juno will be your guide^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
^3355FF我在此授予你這道光柱。朱諾的三位賢者將為你指引方向^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Well, if you already know a little bit about Juno, you'd know that Juno consists of 3 islands that represent propsperity, knowledge and honor.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
你對朱諾有所瞭解的話，應該知道朱諾由三座島嶼組成，分別代表繁榮、知識和榮耀。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
The 3 sages described in the song represent each island. By now, you've probably guessed that I am one of them.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
歌謠中描述的三位賢者分別代表這三座島嶼。到現在，你大概已經猜到我就是其中之一了。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
There is a Juno tradition in which the three best Sages are chosen to represent each of Juno's islands.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
朱諾有一個傳統，選出三位最優秀的賢者來代表朱諾的三座島嶼。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
As one of the three, I will serve as one of your guides in this part of your journey for the doomed sword.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
作為三位賢者之一，我將成為你的嚮導，陪你踏上尋找命運之劍的旅程。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYklah pointed at a pole of the statue with his finger, and you see that there is a strange pattern engraved on the pole.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF伊克拉用手指指向雕像的一根柱子，你看到柱子上刻著奇怪的圖案。^000000

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Now, look at this. This statue was erected to pay tribute to one of the first 3 sages. When you look into the bottom of the pole, you will see several small grooves.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
看這裡。這座雕像是為了紀念最早的三位賢者之一而建的。看柱子底部，會發現幾個小凹槽。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
If you insert some items in the grooves, we may get some more clues relating to the doomed sword.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
如果把一些物品放進凹槽，我們也許能找到更多與命運之劍有關的線索。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
From the stories that I've been told by great Sages, I've figured exactly which items you'll need to place into those grooves.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
根據我從賢者那裡聽來的故事，我已經弄清楚該把哪些物品放進凹槽了。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
You will need...
^3355FF3 Claw of Desert Wolf^000000
^3355FF10 Tooth of Bat^000000
^3355FF1 Piece of Egg Shell^000000.

[Yklah]
Return once you have obtained those items, and we will speak of the doomed sword again.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
等你獲得這些物品後再回來，我們將再次討論命運之劍。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
For your information, you can obtain the claw of desert wolf from the Morocc desert, and the tooth of bat can be found in most caves around the world.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
告訴你一聲，沙漠之狼指甲可以在夢羅克沙漠找到，蝙蝠牙則能在世界各地的大多數洞穴裡找到。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Lastly, the piece of egg shell can be found from solid egg monsters in the Payon cave.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
最後，蛋殼碎片可以從斐揚洞穴裡的實蛋魔物身上獲得。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
From the stories that I've been told by great Sages, I've figured exactly which items you'll need to place into those grooves.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
根據我從賢者那裡聽來的故事，我已經弄清楚該把哪些物品放進凹槽了。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
You will need...
^3355FF3 Claw of Desert Wolf^000000
^3355FF10 Tooth of Bat^000000
^3355FF1 Piece of Egg Shell^000000.

[Yklah]
Return once you have obtained those items, and we will speak of the doomed sword again.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
等你獲得這些物品後再回來，我們將再次討論命運之劍。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
For your information, you can obtain the claw of desert wolf from the Morocc desert, and the tooth of bat can be found in most caves around the world.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
告訴你一聲，沙漠之狼指甲可以在夢羅克沙漠找到，蝙蝠牙則能在世界各地的大多數洞穴裡找到。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Lastly, the piece of egg shell can be found from solid egg monsters in the Payon cave.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
最後，蛋殼碎片可以從斐揚洞穴裡的實蛋魔物身上獲得。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
^3355FFJuphero^000000...
That was the name of the city that once existed in ancient times.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
^3355FF朱菲羅^000000...
這是遠古時代一座城市的名字。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
The most intelligent and talented people of that time lived there, harnessing the pieces of Ymir's heart to power their civilization.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
當時最聰明、最有才華的人都住在那裡，利用依美樂之心的碎片驅動他們的文明。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
Unfortunately, they happened to abuse that great power and somehow destroyed themselves.
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
不幸的是，他們濫用了那股強大的力量，最終毀滅了自己。

scripts.text:
[Yklah]
If you long to acquire God's knowledge, you must first be humble. Otherwise...
scripts.translation:
[伊克拉]
如果你渴望獲得神明的知識，就必須先保持謙遜。否則...

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
What's that?!
Can it be the Stamp of Muriniel?
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
那是什麼？！
難道是穆里尼爾印章嗎？

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
Now, we shall battle to the death to see if you are worthy of possessing this item. Prepare yourself!
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
現在我們要較量一番，看看你是否配得上擁有這件物品。準備好！

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
...
Muhahahahaha!!! Don't worry, I was only messing with you. Yklah told me that you might be coming.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
...Muhahahahaha!!! 別擔心，我只是在逗你玩。伊克拉說你可能會來。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
It is said that The Stamp of Muriniel chooses its owner by its own will, and will not appear otherwise.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
據說穆里尼爾印章會憑自己的意志選擇主人，否則它不會顯現。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
Even though I am one of the three great Sages of Juno, I've never even seen this item before.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
雖然我身為朱諾三大賢者之一，但我從未見過這件物品。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
Yklah gave me an idea about the Stamp of Muriniel you've brought, so we'll try it out as well.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
伊克拉告訴了我你帶來的穆里尼爾印章的事，我們也來試試看。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
The pattern engraved on the Stamp of Muriniel has shapes that are similar to the pattern engraved on this^3355FFStatue of the Goddess Snotora^000000.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
穆里尼爾印章上的圖案，與這座^3355FF斯諾托拉女神像^000000上的圖案形狀相似。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou see for yourself that, indeed, the pattern on the statue of the Goddess Snotora matches that on the Stamp of Muriniel.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你親眼看到，斯諾托拉女神像上的圖案確實與穆里尼爾印章上的圖案相符。^000000

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
When I was young, I learned about a legendary stamp ink related to this statue. But at the time, it made no sense to me. Just how legendary can stamp ink be?
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
我年輕時聽說過一種與這尊雕像有關的傳奇印泥。當時我覺得這毫無意義：印泥能有多傳奇？

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
But now I believe that this stamping ink can be used with this Stamp of Muriniel.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
但現在我相信，這種印泥可以配合穆里尼爾印章使用。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
But even though I've learned how to make this special stamping ink, it is too difficult for me to collect the materials that are necessary to create it.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
雖然我學會了製作這種特殊印泥，但收集製作所需的材料對我來說太難了。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
Okay, if you're ready, please bring me the following items. I feel like making legendary red ink, so bring me...
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
好了，如果你準備好了，請帶給我以下物品。我想製作傳奇紅色印泥，所以請帶來...

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
^3355FF20 Red Herb^000000,
^3355FF5 Stone^000000 and
^3355FF1 Stone Heart^000000.
The Stone Heart will be used as a bottle to hold this special ink.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
^3355FF20株紅色藥草^000000，
^3355FF5塊石頭^000000，
以及^3355FF1顆石心^000000。
石心會被用作容器，盛放這種特殊印泥。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
I think that's all I need. Anyway, I believe that gathering these items shouldn't be a difficult task for you. Good luck to you.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
我想這就是全部所需物品了。總之，收集這些東西對你來說應該不難。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
Hahaha...!
So you've already gathered the items I've asked for. Good, good. Let's get started...
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
哈哈哈...!
原來你已經集齊了我要求的物品。很好，很好。開始吧...

scripts.text: ^3355FFSage Syklah grinded the stones and stone heart and molded them into a strange shape.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF賢者西克拉把石頭和石心磨碎，再塑成奇特的形狀。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFHe then ground the red herbs and placed them into the stone mold.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF接著，他把紅色藥草磨碎，放進石模裡。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFAfterwards, he then took a strangely shaped capsule from his pocket, sprinkled some liquid from it, and began to chant a spell...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF隨後，他從口袋裡拿出一個形狀奇特的膠囊，灑出一些液體，並開始吟唱咒語...^000000

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
Haooooh...
Doo de doo de~ Dah dah dah Dan dan dan Dah dah dah! Nu ha nu ha nu hahaha... Moo hee moo hee moo hee~
- Pah ahhhh !! -
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
Haooooh...
Doo de doo de~ Dah dah dah 當 當 當 Dah dah dah! Nu ha nu ha nu 哈哈哈... Moo hee moo hee moo hee~
- Pah ahhhh !! -

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe Stamping Ink of Muriniel has been created, and has been given to you by the sage Syklah.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF穆里尼爾印泥已經制作完成，並由賢者西克拉交給你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
Now, with this stamping ink, you are able to use the Stamp of Muriniel.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
現在，有了這種墨水，你就可以使用穆里尼爾印章了。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
Now, I don't think you can use the stamp just anywhere. After all, it is a legendary item.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
我想你不能隨便在任何地方使用這個印章。畢竟，它是一件傳奇物品。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
Please visit the Third Sage ^3355FFEsklah^000000 who stays on Solomon, the island of prosperity, here in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
請去拜訪居住在朱諾繁榮之島所羅門的第三位賢者^3355FF埃斯克拉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
He will be able to tell you more about where to use this stamp. However, be careful. He is the most fastidious sage among all of us.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
他能告訴你更多關於印章該在哪裡使用。不過要小心，他是我們當中最吹毛求疵的賢者。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
I hope you will bring me what I need to make the 'Stamp of Muriniel' ink soon.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
希望你能儘快帶給我製作穆里尼爾印泥所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
I will need...
^3355FF20 Red Herb^000000,
^3355FF5 Stone^000000 and
^3355FF1 Stone Heart^000000.

[Syklah]
Please visit ^3355FFEsklah^000000 on the island of prosperity, Solomon. But be careful. He is the most exacting Sage out of all of us.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
請去繁榮之島所羅門拜訪^3355FF埃斯克拉^000000。但要小心，他是我們當中最嚴苛的賢者。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
The people here keep talking of some suspicious man living in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
這裡的人一直在談論一個住在朱諾的可疑男子。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
Supposedly, he's pretty dangerous, and is always immersing himself in some kind of research.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
據說他相當危險，總是沉浸在某項研究中。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
People already consider him a 'Mad Scientist,' wasting his time studying impractical things beyond the understanding of normal people.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
人們已經稱他為“瘋狂科學家”，說他把時間浪費在研究那些超出常人理解的不切實際事物上。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
It's rumored that this scientist is responsible for creating 'Blazer,' a monster made of magic flame.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
傳聞這位科學家創造了“火焰妖”，一種由魔法火焰構成的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Syklah]
It's a dangerous and fearsome monster that casts spells like Fire Bolt and Fire Ball that lives outside of Juno.
scripts.translation:
[西克拉]
這是一種危險可怕的魔物，住在朱諾城外，會施放火箭術、火球術等法術。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Hm...?
You must be the one who holds the Stamp of Muriniel...
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
嗯...？
你就是持有穆里尼爾印章的人吧...

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Heh, you don't look like much. But even though you're ordinary looking, you possess the legendary item!
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
呵，你看起來平平無奇。但儘管外表普通，你卻擁有這件傳奇物品！

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Only a few people in Midgard's history have been chosen to use the ^3355FFStamp of Muriniel.^000000
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
在米德加爾特歷史上，只有少數人被選中使用^3355FF穆里尼爾印章^000000。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
However, it's my job to test whether or not you are truly qualified to possess it.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
然而，我的職責是測試你是否真正有資格擁有它。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Let me tell you about the stamp craftman ^3355FFMuriniel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
讓我給你講講印章工匠^3355FF穆里尼爾^000000的故事。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
This man lived long ago, somewhere in Mt. Mjornir. He was eager in his studies, and wanted to recreate every pattern that existed in the world.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
很久以前，他住在米約尼爾山一帶。他勤於鑽研，想要重現世上所有的圖案。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Believing that people were obstacles to his study of patterns, he lived in seclusion, studying alone.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
他認為人類是他研究圖案的障礙，於是隱居起來，獨自鑽研。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
While studying patterns one day, he happened to find a magic circle that connected this world to another world.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
有一天，他在研究圖案時，偶然發現了一個連線此界與另一世界的魔法陣。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
That circle was totally different from ones used by Mages, Wizards or sages. This pattern had the power to summon an evil creature from the other world.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
那個魔法陣與魔法師、巫師或賢者使用的陣法截然不同。這個圖案能夠從異世界召喚邪惡生物。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
In order to summon the creature, the pattern must be created in the perfect location. Muriniel began to explore various places and finally found the spot he was looking for.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
要召喚那個生物，必須在合適的地點繪製圖案。穆里尼爾開始四處探尋，終於找到了理想之地。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
The place he found is now ^3355FFMuriniel's Cottage^000000. But to see that place, you will first need the ^3355FFCompass of Muriniel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
他找到的地方就是現在的^3355FF穆里尼爾小屋^000000。但要看到那個地方，你首先需要^3355FF穆里尼爾羅盤^000000。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Heh heh. That's right, making the Compass of Muriniel will be my test for you.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
嘿嘿.。沒錯，製作穆里尼爾羅盤就是我對你的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Now listen carefully, I won't tell you more than once. I will need you to collect some items to make the ^3355FFCompass of Muriniel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
現在仔細聽著，我只說一次。我需要你收集一些物品來製作^3355FF穆里尼爾羅盤^000000。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Bring me...
^3355FF2 Iron Ore^000000,
^3355FF10 Acorn^000000 and
^3355FF5 Decayed Nail^000000.

[Esklah]
For someone seeking the doomed sword, this should be a relatively simple task. Now go, and bring me what I have asked.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
對於尋找命運之劍的人來說，這應該是個相對簡單的任務。去吧，把我要求的物品帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Let's see.
2 Iron Ore...
10 Acorn...
5 Decayed Nail...
Good, that's everything!
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
讓我看看。
2塊鐵礦石...
10個橡子...
5個亡者指甲...
好，東西都齊了！

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Good work. Now, while I make the body of the compass, you can go and bring me the rest of the items I'll need.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
幹得好。現在，趁我製作羅盤主體的時候，你可以去把我需要的其餘物品帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Muhahahaha! What's with that look? You know how this kind of business gets done!
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
Muhahahaha! 你那是什麼表情？你知道這類事情就是這麼辦的！

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Now stop whining
and go bring...
^3355FF2 Brigan^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000.
Now isn't that simple?
Muhahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
別抱怨了，
快去帶來...
^3355FF2個布里刊^000000和
^3355FF1個普隆德拉金屬^000000。
這很簡單吧？
Muhahahaha!!

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Now listen carefully. I won't tell you more than once. I need some items to create the ^3355FFCompass of Muriniel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
現在仔細聽著，我只說一次。我需要一些物品來製作^3355FF穆里尼爾羅盤^000000。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Bring me...
^3355FF2 Iron Ore^000000,
^3355FF10 Acorn^000000, and
^3355FF5 Decayed Nail^000000.

[Esklah]
Now...
Show me
what you brought.
That's 2 Brigan and...
1 Phracon. Hmm. Very good.
Now let me get to work.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
現在...
讓我看看
你帶來了什麼。
2個布里刊，還有...
1個普隆德拉金屬。嗯，很好。
現在我開始製作。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Hmm...
Let's see...
There, it's finished.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
嗯...
我看看...
好了，完成了。

scripts.text: ^3355FFSage Esklah handed you the ^3355FFCompass of Muriniel^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF賢者埃斯克拉遞給了你^3355FF穆里尼爾羅盤^000000。

scripts.text: ^3355FFIn the direction the compass is pointing, some words are engraved...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在羅盤指向的方向，刻著一些文字...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF- Mountain Mjornir -^000000
^3355FF- mjolnir_02 . 170 193 -^000000

[Esklah]
Look at the middle of compass carefully to find the place you must use the stamp. I wish you the best of luck in your journey.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
請仔細觀察羅盤的中心，找到你需要使用印章的地方。祝你在旅途中好運。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Listen carefully!
I want you to bring...
^3355FF2 Brigan^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000
Isn't that simple and easy?
Muhahaha! Now, get a move on!
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
仔細聽好了！
我要你帶來...
^3355FF2個布里刊^000000和
^3355FF1個普隆德拉金屬^000000。
這不是很簡單嗎？
Muhahaha! 快去吧！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou look into the compass of Muriniel and take note of the engraving...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你凝視著穆里尼爾羅盤，並記下上面的刻痕...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF- Mountain Mjornir -^000000
^3355FF- mjolnir_02 . 170 193 -^000000

[Esklah]
I remember watching a harmless
piece of paper floating
through the air...
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
我記得曾看見一張無害的紙片在空中飄蕩...

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
As I was thinking of how wonderfully poetic that image was, that paper suddenly attacked me! Me, one of Juno's greatest Sages!
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
我正想著那畫面多麼富有詩意，那張紙突然就攻擊了我！我可是朱諾最偉大的賢者之一啊！

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
I tried defending myself with my trusty sword, but being paper-thin, that monster managed to dodge all of my blows. I had to cast magic in order to destroy it.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
我試著用信賴的劍抵擋，但那魔物薄如紙片，躲開了我所有的攻擊。我只好施展魔法將它消滅。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
Later, I learned that monster is known as ^3355FFThe Paper^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
後來，我得知那魔物被稱為^3355FF紙妖^000000。

scripts.text:
[Esklah]
It used to be a part of an old book that contained a lot of ancient knowledge about Juno, but somehow, became a monster. Isn't that peculiar?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯克拉]
它原本是一本古書的一部分，那本書記載著許多朱諾的古代知識，不知為何它卻變成了魔物。真奇怪，不是嗎？

scripts.text: ^3355FFMuriniel's pattern is carved into the wooden floor.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF穆里尼爾的圖案刻在木地板上。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFUsing the ^9999FFStamp of Muriniel^3355FF and the ^9999FFStamping Ink of Muriniel^3355FF, you fit the stamp into the pattern on the floor.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你用^9999FF穆里尼爾印章^3355FF和^9999FF穆里尼爾印泥^3355FF，將印章按在地板上的圖案中。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Woon Woon*^000000
^3355FFYou can faintly hear someone's voice softly in the distance.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你隱約聽到遠處傳來某人的聲音。^000000

scripts.text:
[Muriniel's Recording]
You, who are in the future, let me introduce myself.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尼爾的記錄]
身處未來的你，請容我自我介紹。

scripts.text:
[Muriniel's Recording]
My name is Muriniel, the stamp craftman living in your past. I appreciate that you have overcome many obstacles to reach this place.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尼爾的記錄]
我是穆里尼爾，來自你們過去的印章工匠。感謝你克服重重障礙來到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Muriniel's Recording]
However, you must first prove that you are qualified to wield the great power of the doomed sword.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尼爾的記錄]
不過，你必須先證明自己有資格駕馭命運之劍的強大力量。

scripts.text:
[Muriniel's Recording]
The great Sages in Juno have helped me to install this magical system in my cottage to leave my message to you, adventurer in the future.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尼爾的記錄]
朱諾的賢者們幫我在小屋裡安裝了這套魔法裝置，好讓我把留言留給未來的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Muriniel's Recording]
I know that you seek more power by obtaining a doomed sword. But not just anyone can handle the might of a doomed sword.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尼爾的記錄]
我知道你想得到命運之劍以獲得更強大的力量。但並非誰都能駕馭命運之劍的威力。

scripts.text:
[Muriniel's Recording]
And I shudder to think what would happen if such power were to fall into evil hands. The test I have prepared cannot begin until Autumn follows a hot summer.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尼爾的記錄]
一想到這股力量落入邪惡之手會釀成什麼後果，我就不寒而慄。我準備的考驗，要等炎夏過後、秋天到來時才能開始。

scripts.text:
[Muriniel's Recording]
I shall give you an item that promises you of the quest I will give you in the future. Return to this place when the trees begin to shed their leaves...
scripts.translation:
[穆里尼爾的記錄]
我會給你一件物品，作為未來交給你任務的憑證。等樹木開始落葉時，再回到這裡...

scripts.text:
[Muriniel's Recording]
Until that time comes, prepare yourself. And stay alive.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尼爾的記錄]
在那之前，做好準備。活下去。

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Bzzzt!*
*Bzzzzzzt--*^000000
^3355FFSuddenly, the Stamp of Muriniel and the Compass of Muriniel break open to reveal a small, shining object.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF突然，穆里尼爾的印章和穆里尼爾的羅盤裂開，露出了一個閃閃發光的小物件。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou have received the ^9999FFDignity of Muriniel^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你獲得了^9999FF穆里尼爾的尊嚴^000000。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou can faintly hear someone's voice coming from somewhere...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你隱約聽到某人的聲音從某處傳來...^000000

scripts.text:
[Muriniel's Recording]
Please remember to return to this place when the trees begin to shed their leaves. Until then, prepare yourself and stay alive.
scripts.translation:
[穆里尼爾的記錄]
請記住，當樹木開始落葉時回到這裡。在那之前，做好準備，活下去。

scripts.text: 'Muriniel's Cottage'
scripts.translation: '穆里尼爾小屋'

scripts.text: ^3355FFFor some reason, that message is written in this place. But what could be so significant about a cottage like this?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF不知為何，這條資訊寫在這個地方。但這間小屋有什麼特別之處嗎？^000000
